description: Supports .NET 10, 9, 8, 7, 6 and 5, plus .NET Framework 4.5+. A drag-and-drop ready, feature-rich WYSIWYG HTML Editor control for Windows Forms applications by SpiceLogic Inc. Switch between visual editing, HTML source mode, and preview mode with synchronized selection across modes. Includes built-in spell checker (NHunspell, OpenOffice, NetSpell dictionaries), customizable toolbar, CSS style builder, table manipulation, image insertion with Base64 embedding, clean MS Word paste conversion to XHTML, FTP image upload, hyperlink management, YouTube video embedding, and a comprehensive content manipulation API with caret positioning, HTML change events, and custom paste handling.
releaseNotes: .NET 10 support is shown first in the NuGet description and readme, with separate badges for modern .NET and .NET Framework. All supported target frameworks are retained. No runtime code changes. ALM feature #683.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
